title: Wildcard permissions on IAM role
finding: An IAM role grants wildcard permissions to all AWS resources.
remediation: Apply least privilege principle. Replace wildcard permissions with specific actions and resources required for the workload. Use IAM Access Analyzer to identify unused permissions.

title: Missing MFA on privileged accounts
finding: Administrative accounts do not require multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Enable MFA for all privileged accounts. Use hardware tokens for root accounts. Enforce MFA through IAM policies.

title: Overly permissive trust policy
finding: An IAM role trust policy allows access from unknown AWS accounts.
remediation: Restrict the trust policy to specific, known AWS accounts and roles. Remove cross-account access that is not explicitly required.

title: Security group allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0
finding: The production security group allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict SSH access to approved bastion hosts or VPN CIDRs. Use Systems Manager Session Manager for shell access instead of open SSH.

title: Public load balancer with no WAF
finding: An Application Load Balancer is exposed to the internet without a Web Application Firewall.
remediation: Attach AWS WAF to the ALB. Configure rules for common web exploits, rate limiting, and IP reputation. Review WAF logs regularly.

title: No network segmentation between environments
finding: Production and staging workloads share the same VPC subnets with no network policies.
remediation: Separate environments into distinct subnets and VPCs. Apply security groups and NACLs to restrict cross-environment traffic.

title: Kubernetes Service exposed via LoadBalancer without restrictions
finding: A Kubernetes Service of type LoadBalancer is publicly accessible with no network policies restricting pod traffic.
remediation: Apply Kubernetes NetworkPolicies to restrict ingress and egress. Use an internal load balancer or ingress controller with authentication.

title: Container runs as root in privileged mode
finding: The Kubernetes workload runs as root in a privileged container.
remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true, drop all capabilities, and remove privileged: true. Use a minimal base image and scan for vulnerabilities in CI.

title: Container image not scanned for vulnerabilities
finding: Container images are deployed without vulnerability scanning in the CI pipeline.
remediation: Integrate image scanning (Trivy, Grype, ECR scanning) into CI/CD. Block deployment of images with critical or high vulnerabilities.

title: Container uses latest tag
finding: The container image uses the 'latest' tag which is mutable and unpredictable.
remediation: Pin images to specific version tags or digests. Use immutable tags and maintain a base image update process.

title: Database password hardcoded in repository
finding: A database password is hardcoded in the Git repository.
remediation: Revoke the exposed credential immediately. Move secrets to a managed store (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault). Rotate the secret and scan git history.

title: API key committed to version control
finding: An API key for a third-party service was committed to the Git repository.
remediation: Revoke the API key immediately. Remove from git history using git filter-branch or BFG. Store in a secrets manager and inject at runtime.

title: No secret rotation policy
finding: Secrets and credentials have not been rotated in over 90 days.
remediation: Implement automatic secret rotation. Use AWS Secrets Manager rotation lambda or Vault dynamic secrets. Set rotation policies for all credentials.

title: S3 bucket with customer records has no encryption
finding: The storage bucket contains customer records with no encryption at rest.
remediation: Enable SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS encryption. Enforce encryption via bucket policy. Enable access logging and audit trails.

title: RDS instance not encrypted at rest
finding: An RDS database instance stores sensitive data without encryption at rest.
remediation: Enable encryption at rest during the next maintenance window. For existing instances, create an encrypted snapshot and restore to a new encrypted instance.

title: No backup retention policy
finding: Database backups are not configured with a retention policy.
remediation: Enable automated backups with appropriate retention (minimum 7 days). Test restore procedures regularly. Store backups in a separate region.

title: Data transmitted over unencrypted channel
finding: Application traffic between services uses HTTP instead of HTTPS.
remediation: Enable TLS for all service-to-service communication. Use mutual TLS (mTLS) where possible. Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

title: Service account with excessive RBAC permissions
finding: A Kubernetes service account has cluster-admin role binding.
remediation: Apply least privilege RBAC. Create custom roles with only required verbs and resources. Audit service account permissions regularly.

title: DNS over UDP without DNSSEC
finding: DNS resolution uses UDP without DNSSEC validation enabled.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC on the hosted zone. Configure DNS resolvers to validate DNSSEC signatures. Monitor for DNS spoofing attempts.

title: Helm chart with default credentials
finding: A Helm chart deploys an application with default admin credentials.
remediation: Override default credentials during deployment. Use Kubernetes secrets or external secret operators. Rotate credentials after initial deployment.
